name: EP (Etoposide / CISplatin)
histology: germ cell tumor (serves BOTH seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT)

biomarkers.note: Bleomycin-sparing platinum doublet. Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) define IGCCCG good risk, the setting where EP for 4 cycles substitutes for BEP for 3 cycles. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer, TEST-E and TEST-D.

lineOfTherapy: first-line combination chemotherapy for IGCCCG good-risk germ cell tumor and for pathologic stage II or viable germ cell tumor at post-chemotherapy surgery; bleomycin-sparing alternative to BEP; not line-scoped when adjuvant

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: IGCCCG good risk, pathologic stage II disease, or viable germ cell tumor at surgery after first-line chemotherapy; or when bleomycin is to be avoided
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, TEST-E EP note (option for good risk [TEST-D], pathologic stage II, and viable GCT at surgery)

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), EP (Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. good-risk EP (line 167550).

drugs.name: CISplatin

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), EP (Cisplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. CISplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5. ISMP tall-man. No lifetime cumulative cap; requires IV pre/post hydration; monitor nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, peripheral neuropathy. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. (line 167550 to 167551).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (high emetic risk)
premedications.notes: Multiday CISplatin is highly emetogenic; high-emetic-risk prophylaxis indicated.

premedications.name: Hydration
premedications.notes: IV pre- and post-hydration with each CISplatin dose.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: high emetic risk (multiday CISplatin). Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.
Nephroprotection: IV hydration and electrolyte repletion with each CISplatin dose.
G-CSF: not routinely mandated; use per febrile-neutropenia risk assessment.

monitoring: Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) before each cycle and at restaging
Renal function (creatinine/GFR) and electrolytes (Mg, K, Na) before each cycle - CISplatin
Ototoxicity and peripheral neuropathy assessment - CISplatin

doseModificationRules.condition: rising creatinine / falling GFR, ototoxicity, or grade 2+ neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Review required; consider dose reduction or delay. Physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 167548 to 167551 (good-risk EP four cycles q21d: etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV daily x5, cisplatin 20 mg/m2 IV daily x5)

guideline.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), EP; risk classification TEST-D; four cycles for good risk (SEM-4)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for EP (Etoposide / CISplatin), the bleomycin-sparing platinum doublet for germ cell tumor. Serves BOTH histologies: seminoma (#60) and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT (#61), under testicular germ cell tumor (#59). Doses from Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer v2.2026, First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E): Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5 and CISplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5, repeat every 21 days for 4 cycles (good risk); corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. (lines 167548 to 167551). Indicated for IGCCCG good risk, pathologic stage II, viable germ cell tumor at post-chemotherapy surgery, and when bleomycin is to be avoided (NCCN TEST-E EP note). CISplatin has no lifetime cumulative cap; hydration and nephro/oto/neuro monitoring are specified. ISMP tall-man applied (CISplatin). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
